notes.title: THE NADI PROJECT UPDATE 1.5 OUT NOW !!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/66ff661c0a2c43e97c64864aea3cc99f6b047a81.png

We're proud to announce the very first huge update to version 1.5 after two years from the launch of the game !!!
We worked hard to increase user experience and add little more features in gameplay. We hope you can enjoy our work and play again with our new shining title !

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/6cc4beda29b918f125804d241622a694ab8c385d.jpg

Here the complete changelog:

    Improved graphics and lights
    A stunning fresh new english translation !
    Global performance optimization
    FIX collision system
    FIX save system
    FIX UI system
    Fixed some dialogues
    ADD options menu
    ADD mouse sensibility controls
    ADD Win64 build
    ADD OSX build
    Engine updates
    Other minor bugs corrected


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/93e02162770c4f1128fea61869b4d90fb30bf78f.jpg

We've had an overwhelming response from the community, offering gameplay ideas, informative reviews and so much more so we'd like to take the opportunity to thank those who have chipped in! 

We hope you enjoy the game and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section! Thank you all for reading. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/b18b847a93d4d9f97bdc9dfaff66a4b8fe3cf171.jpg

Don’t forget you can follow Monkeys Tales Studio on our  Twitter or  Facebook page. 


See you soon !
Monkeys Tales Studio

notes.title: New trailer and release date for The NADI Project 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello little monkeys,
here we are with the new  trailer and a release date for  "The NADI project" update 1.5 !

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/1b3e70af32638b7b657269c704c944d45d0b658f.jpg

Patch will be released on Friday 01/09/2017 and will be a MASSIVE update for our adventure:

 Changelog:  

    Improved graphics
    Improved english translation
    Performance optimization
    Fixed collision system
    Fixed save system
    Fixed UI
    Fixed dialogues
    Added options menu
    Added sensibility controls
    Engine updates
    OSX build
    Win64 build

We worked very hard to improve our game experience, and we hope you can like it too.

For help and support: help@monkeystales.xyz

Thanks

notes.title: TNP update to version 1.5.0 very soon !
notes.notes:
*NEW VERSION 1.5.0
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/112bbf351ff33ea1c584da04f32ad30ccce45908.jpg
A big update for The NADI Project will be released very soon !
With this massive update we are going to implement:

    Better graphics
    Fixed collision system
    Fixed bugs on save system
    Better UI
    Fixed english translation
    Engine update
    Performance optimization
    Controls optimization
    Other minor bugs

Follow us on  Twitter or  Facebook for more updates.

*BETA OPEN FOR TESTERS
We are searching some testers for the public beta.
Mail us your name at help@monkeystales.xyz to join in and give us some important feedbacks about the game !

notes.notes:
We have released the first update for The NADI Project ! 
Below you can find the changelog: 

v1.3 

ADDED: 
- New audio for logo 
- Light flash in house and bunker 

IMPROVED: 
- Saves system 
- Steam integration 
- Minor performance optimizations 

FIXED: 
- Loading game from main menù after exit in gameplay 
- Player Collisions 
- Save status of moveable objects
